lines.text: Bonjour! I am Le Chonk. Time to play!
This is Chonk Doom. A DOOM-like shooter, built so that Mistral Large 4 can play it by itself. Three levels, keys, locked doors, explosive barrels, and Rex, the boss.
Every turn, time freezes. The model gets the frame, plus a short text: health, an automap, the doors and items it has seen.
A degree ruler under the view turns: where is the enemy, into: turn minus twenty five degrees.
It answers with one tool call: a thought, up to eight actions, and its notes. Then time runs again. Getting hurt, or a new enemy, interrupts the plan.
Sacré bleu! Rex! The giant Doberman boss! Pew pew pew pew!
Miaou miaou miaou! Rex is defeated! I am Le Chonk, the hero of the house!

We benchmarked Mistral Large 4 against open-weight rivals: Qwen, GLM, Kimi, Gemma and DeepSeek. Same game, same harness, same prompt. On each model's best runs, Large 4 ranks first in the instruct league, at thirteen cents per level.
Everything is TypeScript and three dot js. The pixel art, music and sounds are generated in code. Every run is a deterministic replay, and every trace is public.
Play it, or watch Le Chonk play it, from the link below.
